convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom to load external '2pbIdealXOSMA' indicator and includes two external .mqh libraries (SmoothAlgorithms.mqh, TradeAlgorithms.mqh) that contain trading logic and custom smoothing classes not available as built-in MT5 indicators.

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - chart period in seconds
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime calculation for position open timing

other_exits: Opposite signal closes existing position: sell signal triggers BuyPosClose, buy signal triggers SellPosClose

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MM input: negative values = fixed lot size (absolute value), positive values = share of deposit in a deal

custom_logic_notes: Entry signal requires histogram slope change: long when macd[1]<macd[2] (declining histogram) AND macd[0]>macd[1] (histogram turning up); short when macd[1]>macd[2] (rising histogram) AND macd[0]<macd[1] (histogram turning down). This is a histogram reversal/divergence pattern. The BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen and BuyPosClose/SellPosClose functions are from TradeAlgorithms.mqh and handle position management internally. SignalBar=1 means signals are read from bar index 1 (last completed bar), not bar 0. When SignalBar=0, signals are evaluated on every tick without new-bar guard. The Recount flag re-fetches data if CopyBuffer fails.
python_conversion_notes: Requires reimplementation of: (1) CXMA class from SmoothAlgorithms.mqh with JJMA and 9 other smoothing methods, (2) TradeAlgorithms.mqh functions (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, GlobalVariableDel_, LoadHistory, CIsNewBar), (3) the external 2pbIdealXOSMA custom indicator which applies triple 2-pair ideal moving average smoothing then computes an OSMA-style histogram. The histogram is a triple-smoothed difference series, not a standard MACD histogram. Signal logic is histogram slope reversal: enter long when declining histogram turns up, enter short when rising histogram turns down. Position sizing is dual-mode: negative MM = fixed lots (abs value), positive MM = deposit fraction. SL/TP are in points (not pips) - note 1000/2000 point values suggest 5-digit broker compatibility already built in. The new-bar guard is bypassed when SignalBar=0, allowing tick-level evaluation.
